totalSeconds.description: Total caller wait from admission after the request body arrives, including preparation. Defaults to 3600 seconds. Never resets or cancels dispatched provider work.

outputIdleSeconds.description: Maximum wait for useful provider output, starting at dispatch and restarting on each useful output. Keepalives and empty lifecycle events do not reset it. Buffered requests wait for the complete response. Defaults to 300 seconds.

timeouts.description: Required values combine by minimum for each timeout. Expiry ends delivery without replay. Dispatched provider work continues and its final usage remains billable.

end.description: The end must be later than the start. Split an overnight period into two entries.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone name, such as America/New_York or UTC.

asciiOnly.description: Reject non-ASCII decoded text in redaction-scanned input fields before redaction. Any parent requirement wins.

unit.description: Provider total tokens by default. STT is decoded input UTF-8 bytes divided by four, charged only for successful billable requests.

lifetimeUsd.description: Exact nonnegative USD, at most 36 decimal places and $1 trillion. No exponent or trailing fractional zeros.

maxUsd.description: Exact nonnegative USD, at most 36 decimal places and $1 trillion. No exponent or trailing fractional zeros.

limits.description: At most 5 counter slots per saved policy, shared across spending windows, request buckets, and token windows. Top-level lifetime spending, lifetime tokens, and concurrency do not use a slot; together within one conditional rule, they use one shared slot. Request-time policies cannot define limits.

url.description: Complete JSON webhook URL. No path is appended.

headers.description: Destination authentication headers. Encrypt the plugins section to keep these private when saved.

destinations.description: Independent destinations from required policies are combined; exact duplicates are sent once. At most eight combined destinations. An empty array adds none and replaces plugin defaults.

stogasTextExtraction.description: Extract inline UTF-8 text attachments before input checks and redaction. Any required true setting enables extraction.

customPattern.description: One RE2 expression, limited to 512 UTF-8 bytes.

items.description: Exact text, up to 256 UTF-8 bytes. Not a regular expression.

values.description: Plain text strings, each at most 256 UTF-8 bytes. Settings apply to every value.

fuzzy.description: Allow one ASCII insertion, deletion, substitution or adjacent swap

literals.description: Groups of literal strings sharing case, boundary and fuzzy settings. At most 1,000 strings and 65,536 UTF-8 text bytes in total.

stogasRedaction.description: An empty object adds no redaction and replaces redaction defaults. Required redaction from other policies still applies.

allowedCatalogNodes.description: A candidate must match each list that is present. Lists share the policy byte budget. An empty object replaces default lists without removing other required lists.

maxAttempts.description: Total attempts, including failed local credential preparations and retries after proven pre-execution rejection. Defaults to one. Timeouts and ambiguous provider failures never permit replay.

filter.description: A CEL filter over catalog facts, request model, route and time. Input-token and cost estimates are unavailable during routing.

by.description: A typed CEL expression. Prices use decimal("...") for exact values.

sort.description: Orders eligible deployments. Each expression must read an author, model, deployment, route or provider field. Credential policies, and rules whose condition reads those fields, cannot set routing.sort.

mode.description: Ordered uses the listed deployment order. Random selects uniformly across eligible deployments without replacement.

targets.description: Canonical deployment IDs from the eligible catalog pool. Required for ordered selection; omission in random mode uses every eligible deployment.

selection.description: An alternative to routing.sort with the same scope and rule restrictions. All required selection settings must agree. Inherited restrictions and an explicit request model still apply.

rules.description: Unordered named rules. Names identify conditional counters and never give precedence.

title: Stogas policy v1
description: Structural editor schema for saved resource policies (organization, folder, grant, role, member, credential, key). Scope controls root registration and delegation targets. Save-time validation checks readable fields, including query grammar, IANA time zones, RE2 safety and cross-field limits. Encrypted plugins are validated at execution. The 262144-byte content limit counts decoded plugin plaintext; storage allows bounded base64 overhead. Unknown properties are rejected.
